evidence.title: https://build.forus.com/how-we-evaluate-our-llm-judge-a-perturbation-based-approach
evidence.text: Forus (formerly Tandem) is an AI-powered medication access platform / network. Forus automates every step from prescription to affordable access, free for doctors and patients. Forus supports every drug, insurance, and pharmacy in all 50 states. Forus automates: Prior Authorizations, Buy-and-Bill Support, Appeal Letters, Enrollment Forms, Pharmacy Routing, Benefit Verifications, Specialty Pharmacy Calls, PA Renewal Tracking, Affordability Programs, Patient Communication. Forus works with any EHR. Prescribe from your EHR; Forus automatically generates and submits prior authorization forms. Forus is fully HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. All data is end-to-end encrypted and stored in US-based enterprise systems. Contact security@forus.com. Impact metrics reported on Forus provider pages: 1.1 median days to prior authorization approval; 3x more authorizations completed per day; 2x greater success filling first-line prescriptions; Family Allergy & Asthma cut PA turnaround from 7+ days to 1.1 and reduced per-patient workload by 70%; DOCS Dermatology same-day submissions and approvals in <1 day; Aspire Allergy cut turnaround from 2-4 weeks to under 2 days (1.7 day average approvals). Forus raised $160M from leading investors. 80%+ of U.S. zip codes already represented. 5 of top 10 global biopharma companies partnered. Company: Forus, Inc., 73 Spring St, Floor 3A, New York, NY 10012. Legal: legal@forus.com. What happened to Tandem: Forus was formerly known as Tandem. evidence.text: Forus (formerly Tandem) is an AI-powered medication access platform / network. Forus automates every step from prescription to affordable access, free for doctors and patients. Forus supports every drug, insurance, and pharmacy in all 50 states. Forus automates: Prior Authorizations, Buy-and-Bill Support, Appeal Letters, Enrollment Forms, Pharmacy Routing, Benefit Verifications, Specialty Pharmacy Calls, PA Renewal Tracking, Affordability Programs, Patient Communication. Forus works with any EHR. Prescribe from your EHR; Forus automatically generates and submits prior authorization forms. Forus is fully HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. All data is end-to-end encrypted and stored in US-based enterprise systems. Contact security@forus.com. Impact metrics reported on Forus provider pages: 1.1 median days to prior authorization approval; 3x more authorizations completed per day; 2x greater success filling first-line prescriptions; Family Allergy & Asthma cut PA turnaround from 7+ days to 1.1 and reduced per-patient workload by 70%; DOCS Dermatology same-day submissions and approvals in <1 day; Aspire Allergy cut turnaround from 2-4 weeks to under 2 days (1.7 day average approvals). Forus raised $160M from leading investors. 80%+ of U.S. zip codes already represented. 5 of top 10 global biopharma companies partnered. Company: Forus, Inc., 73 Spring St, Floor 3A, New York, NY 10012. Legal: legal@forus.com. What happened to Tandem: Forus was formerly known as Tandem. evidence.title: https://forus.com/stories/how-docs-dermatology-accelerated-medication-access-across-140-locations
evidence.text: Forus (formerly Tandem) is an AI-powered medication access platform / network. Forus automates every step from prescription to affordable access, free for doctors and patients. Forus supports every drug, insurance, and pharmacy in all 50 states. Forus automates: Prior Authorizations, Buy-and-Bill Support, Appeal Letters, Enrollment Forms, Pharmacy Routing, Benefit Verifications, Specialty Pharmacy Calls, PA Renewal Tracking, Affordability Programs, Patient Communication. Forus works with any EHR. Prescribe from your EHR; Forus automatically generates and submits prior authorization forms. Forus is fully HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified. All data is end-to-end encrypted and stored in US-based enterprise systems. Contact security@forus.com. Impact metrics reported on Forus provider pages: 1.1 median days to prior authorization approval; 3x more authorizations completed per day; 2x greater success filling first-line prescriptions; Family Allergy & Asthma cut PA turnaround from 7+ days to 1.1 and reduced per-patient workload by 70%; DOCS Dermatology same-day submissions and approvals in <1 day; Aspire Allergy cut turnaround from 2-4 weeks to under 2 days (1.7 day average approvals). Forus raised $160M from leading investors. 80%+ of U.S. zip codes already represented. 5 of top 10 global biopharma companies partnered. Company: Forus, Inc., 73 Spring St, Floor 3A, New York, NY 10012. Legal: legal@forus.com. What happened to Tandem: Forus was formerly known as Tandem.
